what_makes_it_work: The whole carousel is a confession from the child to mum and dad, so the parent is addressed directly and sees their own toddler's behaviour explained as brain development, not misbehaviour. It is her strongest in this set on both measures: 1818 likes and 2519 comments.
lumebook_takeaway: A kids' book brand can copy this almost whole: a toddler's first-person voice to the parents, one 3D child character, 3-4 numbered 'what I feel' points and a single keyword offer.
